name: dotenv
description: Comment-preserving .env parser, editor & CLI for Go. Edit any entry — every other byte survives: comments, blank lines, ordering, quoting. dotenvctl: get/set/unset, env drift matrix, diff, run, GitHub Actions & Vercel secret sync. Docker Compose interpolation, zero dependencies, fuzz-tested.

positioning.audience: Go developers and platform/DevOps engineers who edit, compare, and sync .env files across environments
positioning.problem: every dotenv tool parses to a map and destroys the file on write — comments, ordering, and quoting are lost; none can tell disabled from missing from placeholder
differentiators: byte-exact round trip pinned by fuzz tests
env drift matrix + contract CI gate
selection-based secret sync with placeholder guards
